messages:
mel_cs: Quick sync 
 Orbit dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:30 PT. Quota approved but we need final autoscale curve, loadtest script, and a short enablement checklist for customer ops. tagging @ash_infra @ravi_prod @sara_oncall
ash_infra: I can take autoscale. please confirm expected RPS shape + p95 SLO and I'll propose thresholds and a queue-fallback rule.
ravi_prod: Steady ~140 RPS, quick spikes up to ~500 RPS for 1-2 min, p95 <= 150ms. quota = 1.2M tokens/day.
mel_cs: We're proposing reserved: 2xA100, burst: 4xA100 auto-burst, quota=1_200_000, p95<=150ms. Need autoscale + fallback + loadtest window.
ravi_prod: Autoscale idea: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=12, metric=gpu_util, target=70%. Add prefix caching for common prompts (top 10) to save token compute.
sara_oncall: I'll run a 30m soak + two 2-minute bursts tomorrow 10:00 PT. Mel can someone paste the simple k6 plan? I'll run and monitor traces/alerts.
mel_cs: Small k6 ramp (swap token):
```javascript
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export let options = { stages: [ { duration: '2m', target: 50 }, { duration: '5m', target: 140 }, { duration: '3m', target: 480 }, { duration: '10m', target: 150 } ] }
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({input:'probe'}), { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer TEST', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  sleep(1);
}
```
opsbot: loadtest queued: env=staging | job=orbit-priming-2026-01-08 | start=2026-01-08T17:00:00Z | duration=00:30:00 | owner=sara_oncall
clairie_pm: Note: renewal flag on Orbit account. Usage growth trending below forecast. After the test we should run a joint ops playbook and customer enablement session. I'll own outreach and readiness checklist (Fri EOD).
mel_cs: Action list: 1) @ash_infra provide autoscale policy + queue fallback; 2) @ravi_prod post cache whitelist + model fallback chain; 3) @sara_oncall run soak/bursts and post metrics; 4) @claire_pm schedule customer enablement + joint ops review. I'll attach a one-page runbook about graceful degradation and circuit breakers.
ash_infra: Adding fallback: if avg_queue_ms > 250ms for 30s -> route to compact-variant and create incident ticket. Also adding predictive pre-warm when 1m MA of RPS > 220.
ravi_prod: Cache whitelist posted: endpoints ["/v1/complete","/v1/chat"] top templates -> ~32% token compute reduction. Model fallback chain: base-v2 -> compact-v1 -> tiny-v1. Will post exact model IDs in the runbook.
sara_oncall: Starting warmup in staging now. Will post first 10m metrics in this thread. If alerts trigger I'll page oncall.
mel_cs: Thanks all. Small deliverable: short customer-facing checklist with steps for ops to flip a traffic gate and enable compact fallback. I'll draft and attach after tests. :thumbsup:
